what_this_is: every file published to the paper's private address, and nothing else. The public root is rebuilt to match this list exactly; a file not named here is removed rather than served.

address.why_withheld: the subdomain label is the only credential this paper has (spec #26); publishing it would publish the paper

categories.archive_index: the archive's front page -- the one URL every mayor holds, listing every edition ever printed (spec #26, #27)
categories.editions: one page per published round, kept forever and never overwritten by a later one (spec #27)
categories.edition_images: the one generated image each edition carries (spec #29)
categories.archive_json: the same curated editions in machine-readable form, for a reader that is not a browser
categories.stylesheet: presentation only; carries no game state
categories.robots: the crawler exclusion that keeps the address non-discoverable (spec #26)

files.why_public: the one address every mayor holds; it has to answer with something (spec #26) and that something is the list of every edition (spec #27)
